statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study was ordered under CPT code 93247.
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these intermittent symptoms.
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9.
G45.9 represents transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The denial reason code is CO-29.
The denial is based on the time limit for filing having expired.
